strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.name: Crossbow Ragebot
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.description: Shoots crossbows at targets by itself: loads them, works out the arrow path and fires.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.auto-swi: Switches between the crossbows in your hotbar: to a loaded one to shoot, to an empty one to load it.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.mode.des: Arrow shoots arrows. Firework loads firework rockets into the crossbow: they fly straight and slower, only as far as their flight duration, and there is no rapid fire.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.firework: A firework shot counts as a hit when it passes this close to the target: the explosion hurts everything within 5 blocks, if the rocket has a star.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.auto-loa: Charges empty crossbows by itself. Needs arrows.
Also loads crossbows while there is no target, so the first shot is instant.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.fire-del: The least number of ticks between two shots.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.use-bow-: When Bow Spam is on with its crossbow spamming, this module does the shooting at Bow Spam's delay and also takes loaded crossbows from the inventory. Bow Spam itself then waits, because it would shoot wherever you look.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.protect-: Does not use a crossbow that is nearly broken, so it is not lost.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.min-dura: A crossbow with this percent of its durability left or less is left alone.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.keep-arr: Stops loading when this many arrows or less are left in the inventory, so there is always some for other things.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.pause-on: Does nothing while you are using another item, like eating.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.pause-in: Does nothing while a screen is open.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.pause-pa: Pauses Baritone while there is a target.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.entities: The entities that can be shot at.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.target-m: Single keeps shooting at the one the priority picks. Switch goes round all the targets in range, one shot each, because a mob that was just hit cannot be hurt again for a few ticks.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.players-: Players are shot at before any other kind of target. The others only get a turn when no player can be hit.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.switch-l: The most targets the switch mode goes round.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.range.de: The farthest a target can be.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.min-rang: The closest a target can be. Very close targets are better hit with a sword.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.aim-poin: Which part of the target to aim at.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.visible-: Only targets that you can see (the arrow path is always checked for blocks).
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.attack-b: Whether to shoot baby variants of entities.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.ignore-i: Does not shoot at invisible entities.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.predict-: Aims where a moving target will be when the arrow gets there.
A target that turns, like a circling phantom, is followed along its curve instead of a straight line.
The arrow is made where you are after this tick's step. Aims from there, which matters a lot when you move fast.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.high-arc: When the straight shot is blocked by a block, tries a plunging shot: nearly straight up, coming down on the target about five seconds later. Only for targets that stand still.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.max-flig: Does not shoot when the arrow needs longer than this to arrive.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.accuracy: How close the calculated arrow has to land to the aim point before shooting, in blocks.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.render-p: Draws the path the arrow will take and where it lands.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.shader-e: Draws the effects with a shader: sharp, glowing and animated. When off (or when the shader cannot be used) simple lines are drawn.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.effect-c: Chance: red when the shot is unlikely to hit and green when it is likely. Custom: the two colors below. Rainbow: slowly through all colors.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.primary-: The main color of the effects.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.secondar: The second color: thin lines, the end of the path and the highlights.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.glow.des: How strong the soft glow round the lines is.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.through-: Draws the effects through blocks. When off, blocks hide them.
A reticle on the target that closes in when it locks on, with the hit chance as an arc round it.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.path-rib: A ribbon of light with moving pulses along the path of the shot, and on the arrows on their way.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.impact-b: A shock wave with rays where an arrow hits, a small ring where it misses.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.ground-r: A radar on the ground under the target, with a sweep, a wave and the hit chance round it.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.light-be: A beam of light, like a hologram, over the target.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.fading-t: The path of arrows that are done stays and fades away slowly.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.impact-c: The color of the box where the arrow lands.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.latency-: Aims further ahead by your ping: the server only makes the arrow after your shot arrives, and the target keeps moving.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.lead-off: Aims this many ticks further ahead (or behind with a negative number). Use it to tune the aim for a server.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.render-p: Draws where the target is expected to be when the arrow arrives.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.min-hit-: Only shoots when this many percent of simulated shots (with the random spread of the crossbow) would hit. Lower targets and a moving or far away target lower the chance.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.auto-cal: Watches where your arrows land compared to the target, and moves the aim ahead or back to fix a lead that is always too short or too long.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.debug.de: Writes a very detailed log of every shot to meteor-client/crossbow-ragebot.log, and a csv with a row per shot next to it: the angles it should and did shoot, your movement, the movement of the target, the prediction, the spread the server gave the arrow, and where the arrow really went.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.debug-tr: Also writes a line to the log every tick while there is a target: its positions, speed and the aim. The log gets big fast.
strings.module.crossbow-ragebot.setting.chat-sum: Also writes a short line in the chat for every shot and where its arrow landed.
